Webhooks

Signing secret

        
Every delivery carries an X-Relay-Signature header: the SHA-256 of this secret concatenated with the raw request body. Verify it before trusting a payload.

Pricing models

        
We'll pick one together based on your order volume when the pilot converts.

        

          

            
ModelHow it works

            
              
Per order monitoredFlat fee per order reconciled, whatever the outcome

              
Per order recoveredPay only for orders Relay catches and helps fix

              
% of amount recoveredA share of the money actually recovered per incident
